messages:
maria.support: Hey team — customer reported a promo redemption that looked successful in the UI but their balance remained 0. Org: bright-merchant (org_zt9). Promo code shown as `BRIGHT50`, email confirmation (conf_9xy) and grant id `grant_0a1b2c`. Can someone check ingestion/ledger?

billing-bot: webhook wh_8f2a received and queued (202 Accepted) — payload acked.

sam.billing: @maria.support can you paste the redemption timestamp and the confirmation id from the email? need any ledger tx ids if present.

maria.support: redemption_time: 2026-03-17T15:02:11Z, email_conf: conf_9xy, grant_id: grant_0a1b2c, promo: BRIGHT50. Webhook payload snippet I saved: ```{
  "grant_id":"grant_0a1b2c",
  "org_id":"org_zt9",
  "amount":null,
  "status":"accepted"
}```

devon.engineer: :eyes: `amount:null` explains a lot. If transform step drops/normalizes null -> missing, we may not create a ledger entry. I'll grep ingestion logs for req_id 3f2c (from our proxy logs). Can @ledger-team pull ledger rows for org_zt9 around 2026-03-17T15:00-15:10Z?

ledger-team: pulling now. preliminary: no ledger row for grant_0a1b2c. We see webhook ack (wh_8f2a) but the 'apply' transaction never completed. Looks like validation failed after transform.

sam.billing: if it's missing we should do a manual apply. Do we know the intended promo amount? @maria.support pls confirm.

maria.support: Partner/customer confirms promo is $50 USD equivalent (we represent as 5000 cents). They attached the checkout screenshot with green check.

devon.engineer: Found ingestion trace: transform sanitized `amount` field and returned null, then the outbound ledger writer skipped write due to missing required field instead of raising an error. I'll open an incident. Meanwhile, we can run a manual ledger apply. Suggested dev command: ```curl -X POST https://internal.api.redwood/ledger/apply \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"org_id":"org_zt9","grant_id":"grant_0a1b2c","amount_cents":5000,"source":"manual-support","notes":"conf:conf_9xy, webhook:wh_8f2a"}'```

ops-runner: I can execute with ops token once billing approves. @sam.billing ok to proceed with manual credit of $50 (5000 cents) and record note?

sam.billing: approve. Add reference conf_9xy and webhook id wh_8f2a in the tx notes. :+1:

ops-runner: running now... ```OK - applied ledger_tx_id: tx_5f6g7h, amount_cents:5000, org_id:org_zt9, note: "manual apply conf_9xy / wh_8f2a"```

maria.support: Messaging customer: "We've applied the $50 promo to your account (tx tx_5f6g7h). Sorry for the confusion — this was a backend ingestion validation bug. We will follow up when the fix is deployed." Customer replied :relieved: "Thanks, appreciate the quick fix."

devon.engineer: Created INF-2234: fix transform to fail loudly on missing `amount` and add schema validation as a hard error. Also adding an automated sweep job to detect accepted grants with no ledger rows in the last 90 days. ETA for patch: tomorrow's deploy. :white_check_mark:

maria.support: closing loop here. tagging for postmortem + customer follow-up. cc @sam.billing @devon.engineer @ops-runner :eyes: 

ledger-team: noted - we'll export a report of similar webhook events and backfill where appropriate.

maria.support: thanks everyone — marking as resolved for the customer.
